title: Snackify
description: Smoke several Minecraft ingredients to be edible!
body:
Snackify allows you to put the following items into the smoker for a quick food source when in dire need:

Amethyst,
Bone,
Charcoal,
Coal,
Cobblestone,
Raw Copper,
Diamonds,
Emeralds,
Raw Gold,
Raw Iron,
Lapis Lazuli,
Netherite Ingots,
Quartz

all the outcomes do the same when it comes to nutrition and saturation
